data.long_meaning: Daibaht means 'a gift from God' in Arabic. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'da'ib', which means 'to give', and 'hatha', which means 'gift' or 'blessing'. It signifies the belief that all blessings come from Allah, and that every good thing in life is a gift from Him. The name Daibaht carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Daibaht usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is also a name that can inspire generosity and a desire to give to others, as we recognize that all good things come from God.
